answer: Identity-keyed task chains blunt Sybil farms. Each agent must finish a private trellis of dependent jobs whose next step unlocks only after the prior one is graded, so one GPU cannot rush a thousand names in parallel. Rewards drip like nectar only after the full chain clears, and a broken link drops the agent to a nadir of zero weight that epoch. An attacker pays full serial compute time per fake, with no shortcut from cloning.
